CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by: Region is Tambrauw Regency.

Regional Government is the Regional Head as an element of the Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of governmental affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.

Regent is the Regent of Tambrauw.

Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution which is positioned as an element of the Regional Government administration.

Discrimination is any distinction, harassment and exclusion, whether direct or indirect, based on human differentiation on the basis of religion, tribe, race, ethnicity, social status group, economic status, gender, language, political beliefs which results in the reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of human rights and fundamental freedoms in life both individually and collectively in the political, economic, legal, social, cultural and other aspects of life.

Violence is any act that results in or causes misery and suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.

Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether in the domestic sphere or public in private life.

Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child.

Domestic violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically and or household neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or unlawful deprivation of liberty within the scope of the household.

Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, kidnapping, confinement, forgery, fraud and abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.

Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age including a child in the womb.

Woman is an adult human being of female gender and a person recognized by law as a woman.

Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.

Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or fainting and or causes death.

Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwilling with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence.

Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.

Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process.

Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance.

Institution is an agency/institution/body/within the scope of regional government and/or Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) that provides assistance.

Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.

Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service forum established by the Regional Government in the context of protection services for victims of violence against women and children in Tambrauw Regency.

CHAPTER V

PREVENTION OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Article 10

To prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children, the Regional Government conducts socialization, empowerment, and awareness to families, parents, and the community by providing information, guidance and / or counseling.

In addition to empowerment and awareness as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Government makes efforts as follows: increasing the quantity and quality of education both formal and non-formal as well as informal;

opening employment opportunities for women;

building community participation and concern for the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, universities and various non-governmental organizations that work and/or care about women and children.

Article 9

The obligations of family and/or parents as referred to in Article 6 letter c and letter d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

CHAPTER VII

INSTITUTIONAL ARRANGEMENTS

Article  13

In the context of providing protection services to women and children from victims of violence, the Regional Government establishes P2TP2A as an integrated service center for the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.

P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) functions as an integrated service center in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.

P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) above consists of the Health Office, Hospital, Police, Social Service, Manpower Office, Women's Empowerment and Family Planning Office, Non-Governmental Organizations.

P2TP2A as referred to Community Organizations, Social Community Organizations, Universities in paragraph (3) is established by Regent's Decree.

P2TP2A of Tambrauw Regency in carrying out its duties and functions may coordinate with service unit networks and competent parties in making efforts to protect women and children from acts of violence.

Article 18

The Regional Government may provide financial assistance to community organizations, social organizations or non-governmental organizations that implement the protection of women and children from acts of violence and discrimination.

Financial assistance as referred to in paragraph (1), is in accordance with regional financial capacity, and is carried out in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations in the field of regional finance.

CHAPTER IV

OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Article 6

Obligations and responsibilities in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence are the joint responsibility of: regional government;.

community;

family; and parents.

REGENT OF TAMBRAUW

WEST PAPUA PROVINCE

REGIONAL REGULATION OF TAMBRAUW REGENCY

NUMBER 3 YEAR 2016

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

BY THE GRACE OF GOD ALMIGHTY

REGENT OF TAMBRAUW,

Considering:
that acts and treatment of violence against women and children constitute actions that violate the rights and dignity of women and children as human beings;

that the implementation of prevention and protection for women and children as victims of acts of violence in Tambrauw Regency has not been carried out optimally;

that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a and letter b, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Protection of Women and Children From Acts of Violence;

In View of:

ELUCIDATION

OF

REGIONAL REGULATION OF TAMBRAUW REGENCY

NUMBER 3 YEAR 2016

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services for Victims of Violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

CHAPTER VIII

REPORTING

Article 16

P2TP2A of Tambrauw Regency is obliged to report the implementation of the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence to the Regent.

Reporting as referred to in paragraph (1) includes: Administration;

Finance;

Services; and Performance.

Submission of written reports as referred to in paragraph (2) is carried out at least once every 3 (three) months.

Article 15

In the context of preventing acts of violence against children including the protection of children from the worst forms of child labor, a committee for the elimination of acts of violence against children will be established by Regent's Decree.

Further provisions regarding the duties and functions of the committee for the elimination of acts of violence against children as referred to in paragraph (1) are regulated by Regent's Regulation.

Article 2

Point a Sufficiently Clear Point  b What is meant by "respect for the rights of victims" is a series of actions to respect, appreciate and ensure the fulfillment of the rights of victims.

Point c What  is  meant  by  "gender justice and equality" is a process to be fair to men and women and equal conditions for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings, so as to be able to play a role and participate in political, economic, social, cultural, national defense and security activities and equality in enjoying the results of such development.

Point d Sufficiently Clear Point e What is meant by "non-discrimination" is an attitude and treatment toward victims by not making distinctions based on age, gender, race, ethnicity, religion and between groups.

Point f What is meant by "the best interests of the victim" is all the best actions concerning victims carried out by the Regional Government, society, legislative bodies and judicial bodies, so that the best interests of the victim must be the primary consideration.

CHAPTER IX

FINANCING

Article 17

Financing for the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence is sourced from: Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget (APBD) of Tambrauw Regency, and Other legitimate sources in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

Article 17

Sufficiently Clear

REGIONAL HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES OF TAMBRAUW REGENCY

REGENT OF TAMBRAUW

HAS DECIDED:

To Establish:  	REGIONAL REGULATION CONCERNING PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE.

Article 14

For the implementation of services for victims of trafficking in persons, the Regent of Tambrauw establishes a task force on the criminal act of trafficking in persons.

The task force on the criminal act of trafficking in persons as referred to in paragraph (1) is a coordinating institution tasked with coordinating the prevention and handling of trafficking in persons.

Further provisions regarding the establishment, duties, and functions of the task force on the criminal act of trafficking in persons as referred to in paragraph (1) are established by Regent's Decree.

Article 7

Sufficiently clear.

REGIONAL REGULATION OF TAMBRAUW REGENCY

NUMBER 3 YEAR 2016

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services for Victims of Violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

CHAPTER V

PREVENTION OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Article 10

To prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children, the Regional Government conducts socialization, empowerment, and awareness to families, parents, and the community by providing information, guidance and / or counseling.

In addition to empowerment and awareness as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Government makes efforts as follows: increasing the quantity and quality of education both formal and non-formal as well as informal;

opening employment opportunities for women;

building community participation and concern for the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, universities and various non-governmental organizations that work and/or care about women and children.

CHAPTER VII

INSTITUTIONAL ARRANGEMENTS

Article  13

In the context of providing protection services to women and children from victims of violence, the Regional Government establishes P2TP2A as an integrated service center for the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.

P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) functions as an integrated service center in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.

P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) above consists of the Health Office, Hospital, Police, Social Service, Manpower Office, Women's Empowerment and Family Planning Office, Non-Governmental Organizations.

P2TP2A as referred to Community Organizations, Social Community Organizations, Universities in paragraph (3) is established by Regent's Decree.

P2TP2A of Tambrauw Regency in carrying out its duties and functions may coordinate with service unit networks and competent parties in making efforts to protect women and children from acts of violence.

Article 9

The obligations of family and/or parents as referred to in Article 6 letter c and letter d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

CHAPTER IV

OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Article 6

Obligations and responsibilities in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence are the joint responsibility of: regional government;.

community;

family; and parents.

Article 15

In the context of preventing acts of violence against children including the protection of children from the worst forms of child labor, a committee for the elimination of acts of violence against children will be established by Regent's Decree.

Further provisions regarding the duties and functions of the committee for the elimination of acts of violence against children as referred to in paragraph (1) are regulated by Regent's Regulation.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services for Victims of Violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

NUMBER 3 YEAR 2016

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services for Victims of Violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

opening employment opportunities for women;

building community participation and concern for the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, universities and various non-governmental organizations that work and/or care about women and children.

CHAPTER IV

OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Article 6

Obligations and responsibilities in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence are the joint responsibility of: regional government;.

community;

family; and parents.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services for Victims of Violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

opening employment opportunities for women;

building community participation and concern for the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, universities and various non-governmental organizations that work and/or care about women and children.

Violence is any act that results in or causes misery and suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.

Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age including a child in the womb.

Woman is an adult human being of female gender and a person recognized by law as a woman.

Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. CONCERNING

BY THE GRACE OF GOD ALMIGHTY

REGENT OF TAMBRAUW,

Considering:
that acts and treatment of violence against women and children constitute actions that violate the rights and dignity of women and children as human beings;

that the implementation of prevention and protection for women and children as victims of acts of violence in Tambrauw Regency has not been carried out optimally;

that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a and letter b, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Protection of Women and Children From Acts of Violence;

In View of:

ELUCIDATION

OF

REGIONAL REGULATION OF TAMBRAUW REGENCY

NUMBER 3 YEAR 2016

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services for Victims of Violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

Article 18

The Regional Government may provide financial assistance to community organizations, social organizations or non-governmental organizations that implement the protection of women and children from acts of violence and discrimination.

Financial assistance as referred to in paragraph (1), is in accordance with regional financial capacity, and is carried out in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations in the field of regional finance.

CHAPTER VII

INSTITUTIONAL ARRANGEMENTS

Article  13

In the context of providing protection services to women and children from victims of violence, the Regional Government establishes P2TP2A as an integrated service center for the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.

P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) functions as an integrated service center in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.

P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) above consists of the Health Office, Hospital, Police, Social Service, Manpower Office, Women's Empowerment and Family Planning Office, Non-Governmental Organizations.

P2TP2A as referred to Community Organizations, Social Community Organizations, Universities in paragraph (3) is established by Regent's Decree.

P2TP2A of Tambrauw Regency in carrying out its duties and functions may coordinate with service unit networks and competent parties in making efforts to protect women and children from acts of violence.

Article 9

The obligations of family and/or parents as referred to in Article 6 letter c and letter d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

community;

family; and parents.

FINANCING

Article 2

Point d Sufficiently Clear Point e What is meant by "non-discrimination" is an attitude and treatment toward victims by not making distinctions based on age, gender, race, ethnicity, religion and between groups.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services for Victims of Violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

Domestic violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically and or household neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or unlawful deprivation of liberty within the scope of the household.

Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, kidnapping, confinement, forgery, fraud and abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.

Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age including a child in the womb.

Woman is an adult human being of female gender and a person recognized by law as a woman.

Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.

Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or fainting and or causes death.

Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwilling with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence.

Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.

Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process.

Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance.

Institution is an agency/institution/body/within the scope of regional government and/or Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) that provides assistance.

Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.

Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service forum established by the Regional Government in the context of protection services for victims of violence against women and children in Tambrauw Regency.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by: Region is Tambrauw Regency.

Regional Government is the Regional Head as an element of the Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of governmental affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.

Regent is the Regent of Tambrauw.

Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution which is positioned as an element of the Regional Government administration.

Discrimination is any distinction, harassment and exclusion, whether direct or indirect, based on human differentiation on the basis of religion, tribe, race, ethnicity, social status group, economic status, gender, language, political beliefs which results in the reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of human rights and fundamental freedoms in life both individually and collectively in the political, economic, legal, social, cultural and other aspects of life.

Violence is any act that results in or causes misery and suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.

Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether in the domestic sphere or public in private life.

Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child.

Domestic violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically and or household neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or unlawful deprivation of liberty within the scope of the household.

Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, kidnapping, confinement, forgery, fraud and abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.

Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age including a child in the womb.

Woman is an adult human being of female gender and a person recognized by law as a woman.

Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.

Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or fainting and or causes death.

Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwilling with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence.

Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.

Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process.

Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance.

Institution is an agency/institution/body/within the scope of regional government and/or Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) that provides assistance.

Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.

Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services for Victims of Violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

BY THE GRACE OF GOD ALMIGHTY

REGENT OF TAMBRAUW,

Considering:
that acts and treatment of violence against women and children constitute actions that violate the rights and dignity of women and children as human beings;

that the implementation of prevention and protection for women and children as victims of acts of violence in Tambrauw Regency has not been carried out optimally;

that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a and letter b, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Protection of Women and Children From Acts of Violence;

In View of:

REGIONAL HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES OF TAMBRAUW REGENCY

REGENT OF TAMBRAUW

HAS DECIDED:

To Establish:  	REGIONAL REGULATION CONCERNING PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE.

CHAPTER IX

FINANCING

Article 17

Financing for the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence is sourced from: Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget (APBD) of Tambrauw Regency, and Other legitimate sources in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

CHAPTER VIII

REPORTING

Finance;

Services; and Performance.

Further provisions regarding the establishment, duties, and functions of the task force on the criminal act of trafficking in persons as referred to in paragraph (1) are established by Regent's Decree.

CHAPTER VII

INSTITUTIONAL ARRANGEMENTS

Article  13

In the context of providing protection services to women and children from victims of violence, the Regional Government establishes P2TP2A as an integrated service center for the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.

P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) functions as an integrated service center in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.

P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) above consists of the Health Office, Hospital, Police, Social Service, Manpower Office, Women's Empowerment and Family Planning Office, Non-Governmental Organizations.

P2TP2A as referred to Community Organizations, Social Community Organizations, Universities in paragraph (3) is established by Regent's Decree.

P2TP2A of Tambrauw Regency in carrying out its duties and functions may coordinate with service unit networks and competent parties in making efforts to protect women and children from acts of violence.

Article 18

The Regional Government may provide financial assistance to community organizations, social organizations or non-governmental organizations that implement the protection of women and children from acts of violence and discrimination.

Financial assistance as referred to in paragraph (1), is in accordance with regional financial capacity, and is carried out in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations in the field of regional finance.

CHAPTER V

PREVENTION OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Article 10

To prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children, the Regional Government conducts socialization, empowerment, and awareness to families, parents, and the community by providing information, guidance and / or counseling.

In addition to empowerment and awareness as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Government makes efforts as follows: increasing the quantity and quality of education both formal and non-formal as well as informal;

opening employment opportunities for women;

building community participation and concern for the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, universities and various non-governmental organizations that work and/or care about women and children.

CHAPTER IV

OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Article 6

Obligations and responsibilities in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence are the joint responsibility of: regional government;.

community;

family; and parents.

Point a Sufficiently Clear Point  b What is meant by "respect for the rights of victims" is a series of actions to respect, appreciate and ensure the fulfillment of the rights of victims.

Point d Sufficiently Clear Point e What is meant by "non-discrimination" is an attitude and treatment toward victims by not making distinctions based on age, gender, race, ethnicity, religion and between groups.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by: Region is Tambrauw Regency.

Regional Government is the Regional Head as an element of the Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of governmental affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.

Regent is the Regent of Tambrauw.

Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution which is positioned as an element of the Regional Government administration.

Discrimination is any distinction, harassment and exclusion, whether direct or indirect, based on human differentiation on the basis of religion, tribe, race, ethnicity, social status group, economic status, gender, language, political beliefs which results in the reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of human rights and fundamental freedoms in life both individually and collectively in the political, economic, legal, social, cultural and other aspects of life.

Violence is any act that results in or causes misery and suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.

Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether in the domestic sphere or public in private life.

Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child.

Domestic violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically and or household neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or unlawful deprivation of liberty within the scope of the household.

Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, kidnapping, confinement, forgery, fraud and abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.

Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age including a child in the womb.

Woman is an adult human being of female gender and a person recognized by law as a woman.

Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.

Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or fainting and or causes death.

Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwilling with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence.

Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.

Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process.

Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance.

Institution is an agency/institution/body/within the scope of regional government and/or Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) that provides assistance.

Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.

Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service forum established by the Regional Government in the context of protection services for victims of violence against women and children in Tambrauw Regency.

OF

REGIONAL REGULATION OF TAMBRAUW REGENCY

NUMBER 3 YEAR 2016

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services for Victims of Violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services for Victims of Violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

Discrimination is any distinction, harassment and exclusion, whether direct or indirect, based on human differentiation on the basis of religion, tribe, race, ethnicity, social status group, economic status, gender, language, political beliefs which results in the reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of human rights and fundamental freedoms in life both individually and collectively in the political, economic, legal, social, cultural and other aspects of life.

Violence is any act that results in or causes misery and suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.

Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age including a child in the womb.

Woman is an adult human being of female gender and a person recognized by law as a woman.

Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.

Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwilling with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence.
